summary.zh-CN: 会话置顶更持久，定时任务会话有了独立视图。
summary.en-US: Persistent session pins and a dedicated view for scheduled conversations.

title.en-US: Keep pins across refreshes and restarts

body.zh-CN: 置顶保存在实例中，较旧的置顶会话也优先显示。旧浏览器置顶自动迁移，已取消的置顶不会被缓存恢复；保存失败时恢复原状态并提示错误。
body.en-US: Pins are stored in the instance, with older pinned conversations also shown first. Existing browser pins migrate without restoring a saved unpin. Failed saves restore the previous state and show an error.

body.zh-CN: 桌面和手机可切换到定时任务视图，集中查看任务创建的专属会话，支持服务端搜索、分页和视图选择持久化。任务绑定的已有普通会话保留原分类。
body.en-US: Desktop and mobile now offer a Scheduled view for dedicated task conversations, with server-side search, pagination, and a persistent view selection. Existing regular conversations bound to a task keep their original classification.

body.zh-CN: 新增 `nextclaw sessions pin <key>` 和 `nextclaw sessions unpin <key>`，与会话列表共用持久化设置。
body.en-US: Use `nextclaw sessions pin <key>` and `nextclaw sessions unpin <key>` with the same persistent settings as the conversation list.
